CVE-2026-93687 affects npm braces at 3.0.3, which remains the latest release on the public npm registry, and Docker Scout reports no fixed version yet. The component is listed in the temporalio-ui-server SPDX SBOM generated from the pruned production node_modules tree at image build time. The runtime image ships the Go ui-server binary and static assets under /home/ui-server, not node_modules. Reachability of the uncontrolled recursion path in the published artifact is under assessment until upstream publishes a patched braces release.

CVE-2026-93687 (uncontrolled recursion in braces) affects braces 3.0.3, which is a transitive dependency in the Trigger.dev self-hosted webapp node_modules tree. Tracking upstream braces and Trigger.dev for a fix release and assessing whether glob/minimatch call paths that reach braces are exercised in the self-hosted webapp runtime.
